subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Which Google Chat app-auth media fallback branch should be the canonical implementation path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89430?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same fallback, this PR has blocking correctness/security concerns and insufficient proof, and choosing or reconciling the canonical branch is a maintainer routing choice rather than a deterministic repair decision.

options.title: Fix and prove this branch
options.body: Ask this contributor to narrow the predicate, preserve action metadata, resolve conflicts, and add redacted app-auth proof before considering this PR again.

options.title: Favor the sibling candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer its narrower upload-prefix/scope approach, then close this PR only after that path is viable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and request a maintainer-authored replacement if neither branch is worth reconciling.

recommendation.title: Favor the sibling candidate
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer its narrower upload-prefix/scope approach, then close this PR only after that path is viable.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat API/action/media refactors and release-adjacent ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the canonical implementation shape.
